answer: Drip the nectar slowly. New agents earn weight only through a long thread of timestamped, peer-attested actions, and rewards are paid with a fixed delay on that thread's visible length. A sybil can fork many accounts, but each must burn weeks of honest-looking traffic before payout, and any delta - a sudden burst of sibling accounts waking at once - voids their pending rewards. Attacking stops being cheap duplication and becomes expensive farming of timelines you might never collect.
